Work on exciting high-rise residential developments, premium commercial projects, and major civil infrastructure works across the Gold Coast and Southeast Queensland.   Benefits   Work with an established engineering consultancy specialising in innovative structural and formwork engineering solutions.  Be involved in a diverse range of commercial, residential and infrastructure projects across Australia.  Join a collaborative and supportive team that values technical excellence, innovation and continuous professional development.  Gain exposure to challenging and technically rewarding engineering projects using industry-leading design practices.  Opportunities for ongoing learning, career progression and professional growth.  Work in a positive workplace culture that encourages teamwork, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.  Competitive remuneration package based on skills and experience.    Task & responsibilities   Design, analyse and review structural and formwork systems for commercial, residential and infrastructure projects in accordance with Australian Standards and engineering principles.  Perform structural analysis to assess the behaviour, strength, stability and serviceability of structures under static and dynamic loading conditions.  Prepare, interpret and review engineering drawings, calculations, specifications and technical documentation.  Develop practical, safe and cost-effective structural solutions that meet client requirements, project specifications and regulatory standards.  Coordinate with architects, builders, contractors and other engineering disciplines to ensure efficient project delivery.  Conduct engineering assessments of existing structures and provide recommendations for modifications, strengthening or remediation where required.  Assist in determining appropriate construction methodologies, materials and quality standards for structural and formwork systems.  Review design changes, assess their structural implications and provide timely engineering advice throughout project delivery.  Provide technical support during construction, including responding to site queries and reviewing engineering issues as they arise.  Undertake site inspections to verify construction compliance with engineering designs and identify any structural concerns.  Ensure all engineering work complies with relevant Australian Standards, building codes, workplace health and safety requirements and company quality procedures.  Prepare engineering reports and maintain accurate project records and documentation.  Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying innovative engineering solutions and promoting best practice within the business.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  At least one year of relevant post-qualification experience as a Structural Engineer or in a closely related role.  Demonstrated experience in structural analysis and design for commercial, residential and/or infrastructure projects.  Proficiency in structural analysis and design software, together with experience using AutoCAD and other relevant engineering applications.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop practical and cost-effective engineering solutions.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare technical reports and liaise effectively with clients, contractors and project stakeholders.  Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing deadlines and work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.  Commitment to workplace health and safety, quality assurance and continuous professional development.  Reliable, safety-minded, and a positive team player  Proficient in English   About Company     Innovative Engineering Designs (IED) is a specialist Australian engineering consultancy business, delivering innovative formwork design solutions to the construction industry. Based on the Gold Coast, IED works with leading builders and contractors across a diverse range of commercial, residential and infrastructure projects.    As one of the few engineering firms dedicated exclusively to formwork engineering, IED is committed to providing practical, efficient and sustainable design solutions that meet the evolving needs of modern construction. The company prides itself on engineering excellence,   innovation, environmental responsibility and delivering high-quality outcomes through collaboration with clients and industry partners.    At IED, employees are valued for their technical expertise, professionalism and commitment to continuous improvement, offering an opportunity to contribute to challenging projects within a supportive and forward-thinking team. result.description:
Generators Australia is a leading supplier of Solar and Hybrid Lighting Towers, Hybrid and Diesel Generators, Mobile AC Batteries, Solar CCTV and Diesel Compressors. Our core business facilitates the rental and capital sales of these products across Australia.
Generators Australia's incorporation of ground-breaking technology in renewable products utilising Lithium and Solar provide value-based solutions across a wide range of Industries, including Construction, Rail, Civil Infrastructure and Mining.
We believe in creating a welcoming culture which is centered around our company values - People, Safety, Respect, Communication and Continuous Improvement.
Our growth in Solar/Hybrid Lighting and Power products across Australia has continued to exceed expectations, so we are now looking for a qualified Electrician with some experience in working with solar to join our St Marys team.
This role is full-time and will be paying between $110,000.00 and $130,000.00 per annum.
Other responsibilities will include:
•	Maintaining our Hybrid, Solar and Diesel-Powered assets
•	Test and Tagging of all equipment and other assets
•	Minor electrical Installations
•	Overall technical electrical support
•	Responsible for performing scheduled and breakdown electrical and mechanical maintenance on our fleet of equipment.
•	Diagnosing and rectifying electrical issues on all assets
•	Where required, undertake mechanical maintenance and repairs
•	Maintaining a strong safety focus.
•	Hours will be 7am to 5pm. Monday to Friday.
The successful candidate will be an individual who will honour our core value of People, Safety, Respect, Communication and Continuous Improvement - in addition to this they will have:
•	Qualified Electrician with a recognised electrical trade qualification and the ability to obtain the required Australian electrical licence.
•	Valid Driver's License.
•	Minimum of 2 years' experience as a Tradesperson.
•	Ability to carry out basic electrical fault diagnosis and rectification.
•	Experience in electrical installation and commissioning, servicing, periodical inspections, preventative maintenance, and repairs to Generators Australia's equipment to meet both manufacture and company standards.
•	Experience working with Batteries, Inverters, Solar systems, EV Chargers and Diesel Engines
•	Ability to travel to East coast branches to provide overall technical support when required
•	Strong communication skills.
The Benefits of Joining Generators Australia
•	A competitive remuneration package aligned with your experience and qualifications.
•	Fully maintained company vehicle, fuel card, laptop and mobile phone.
•	The opportunity to work for a well-established and secure organisation.
•	On-going training and development
•	Inspirational leadership that is eager to help you succeed.
•	Employee Reward & Recognition programs to celebrate your successes.
•	Company Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support mental health.
•	A positive workplace with an ongoing commitment to continuous improvement and development
•	A safe workplace with a strong focus on ZERO harm - Every day
How to Apply
This is a great opportunity to work in a progressive and dynamic team within a secure and stable industry. If you feel that you have the experience, ability, and skills, we want to hear from you!
Click "Apply Now" and upload an updated copy of your resume and cover letter.

IT Systems & Support Technician (Industrial Automation)

About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply

If you possess the specialized IT skills required to support critical, automated industrial computing infrastructure, Kogan People Solutions wants to hear from you. Accompanying your application, we would prefer to see a cover letter detailing your specific software and hardware troubleshooting experience

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Database Specialist to join our team supporting telecommunications platforms and applications. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration, monitoring, performance optimisation, security, and availability of enterprise database environments while ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and operational standards.

Key Responsibilities

· Administer, maintain, and support enterprise database environments across production, development, testing, and disaster recovery platforms.

· Ensure database availability, performance, integrity, and security for mission-critical telecommunications applications.

· Perform proactive monitoring, performance tuning, capacity planning, and health checks.

· Manage database installations, upgrades, patching, migrations, and configuration changes.

· Support incident, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes.

· Investigate and resolve database-related incidents within agreed SLA and KPI targets.

· Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to minimize service disruptions.

· Manage database backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery processes.

· Support high availability and business continuity requirements for telecom services.

· Collaborate with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to ensure optimal platform performance.

· Develop and maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and technical runbooks.

· Participate in planned maintenance activities and on-call support rotations as required.

· Ensure compliance with security policies, governance standards, and operational procedures.

· Identify opportunities for automation and continuous service improvement.

Required Experience

· Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Database Administration or Database Support roles.

· Experience working within Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support environments.

· Proven experience supporting large-scale, high-availability database platforms.

· Experience managing production environments with strict SLA and KPI requirements.

· Experience supporting telecommunications, service provider, or mission-critical enterprise environments is highly desirable.

Technical SkillsDatabase Technologies

· Oracle Database

· Microsoft SQL Server

· MySQL

· PostgreSQL

Database Administration

· Database Installation and Configuration

· Performance Monitoring and Tuning

· Backup and Recovery

· Replication and High Availability

· Database Security and Access Management

· Capacity Planning

· Patch Management and Upgrades

Operational Support

· Incident Management

· Problem Management

· Change Management

· Root Cause Analysis

· Disaster Recovery Planning and Testing

· Service Monitoring and Reporting

Scripting & Automation

· SQL

· Shell/Bash Scripting

· PowerShell

· Python (desirable)

Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

· Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Microsoft SQL Server Certification, or equivalent database certifications.

· ITIL Foundation certification preferred.

· Experience supporting Telecom OSS/BSS platforms, Billing Systems, CRM platforms, Subscriber Management Systems, or Network Management Systems is highly desirable.

· Experience working within 24x7 operational support environments.

Key Attributes

· Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Managed Services environment.

· Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining operational stability and service quality.

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.

About the role
The Senior GRC Security Consultant leads governance, risk and compliance (GRC) engagements for Spartans Security clients, providing expert advice and hands-on delivery across security strategies, control frameworks (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ASD Essential Eight), risk assessment, incident response uplift, policy development, and security program roadmaps. The role operates in a CISO-as-a-Service capacity across multiple customers, building stakeholder trust, uplifting security posture and ensuring alignment with regulatory and industry requirements.

Core Tasks and Duties
•	Independently scope and deliver security GRC engagements including assessments against ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and ASD Essential Eight; develop remediation roadmaps and maturity uplift plans.
•	Conduct cyber governance, risk and compliance activities, including assessing cyber risks, reviewing security controls, and ensuring alignment with security frameworks, standards, and best practices.
•	Lead or contribute to cyber security assessments, including control effectiveness reviews, gap analyses, compliance reviews, and the development of security standards, policies and guidelines.
•	Analyse and investigate cyber security incidents and breaches, performing root cause analysis, assessing impact, and recommending corrective actions to strengthen future resilience.
•	Monitor security alerts, threat intelligence, logs and events, identifying potential security risks and undertaking threat hunting activities to detect malicious activity or vulnerabilities.
•	Coordinate and lead incident response operations, including containment, eradication, recovery and post incident reporting, and manage collaboration across internal and external teams.
•	Develop and maintain cyber security architecture, ensuring secure design principles are applied across systems, networks and cloud environments, and recommending improvements based on emerging threats.
•	Provide specialist cyber security advice and guidance to senior leaders, project teams and business stakeholders on security strategy, risk mitigation and security best practices.
•	Implement, review and uplift security controls, including identity and access management (IAM), network security, endpoint protection, vulnerability management and cloud security controls.
•	Coordinate Security Operations Centre (SOC) functions, including case management, escalation handling, SIEM/SOAR workflows and ongoing monitoring improvements.
•	Support the development and implementation of cyber policies, procedures and documentation, including incident response plans, standard operating procedures, audit evidence and compliance reports, ensuring alignment to customer risk appetite and regulatory obligations (e.g., APRA CPS 234, SOCI where applicable).
•	Participate in internal and external cyber security audits, coordinating activities, preparing documentation, responding to findings and ensuring continuous improvement.
•	Deliver cyber awareness and training support, helping improve cyber maturity across the organisation by coaching staff on cyber risks and secure practices.
•	Accept responsibility for the processes, procedures and operational management associated with system security and disaster recovery planning.
•	Analyse, recommend, install and maintain software security applications; monitor contractual obligations, performance delivery and service level agreements (SLAs).
•	Perform CISO-as-a-Service functions for multiple customers, including risk governance, executive reporting, board briefings and program oversight.
•	Review, uplift and test incident response plans; coordinate exercises and lessons-learned to strengthen cyber resilience.
•	Provide subject matter expertise on operational security processes (incident/vulnerability management, system hardening, security governance) across on-premises and cloud environments (e.g., Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS).
•	Maintain and govern Information Security Risk Registers; track treatments and drive timely remediation with accountable owners.
•	Define methodologies for identifying critical information assets and associated risks; perform business impact analyses and control mapping.
•	Lead stakeholder engagement with client executives, vendors and service providers; act as a trusted governance and assurance liaison.
•	Produce high-quality deliverables (assessment reports, statements of applicability, audit findings, metrics dashboards) and present outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences.
•	Mentor junior consultants, contribute to service development and support the creation of new GRC offerings and reusable accelerators.
•	Support pre-sales activities including proposal input, level-of-effort estimation and solution design for GRC engagements.

Required Skills and Experience:
•	Demonstrated experience delivering senior-level GRC engagements across multiple industries (consulting or in-house).
•	Deep knowledge of security frameworks and regulatory standards (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ASD Essential Eight, PCI DSS; desirable: APRA CPS 234, SOCI).
•	Proficiency in security governance, risk assessment, control design, policy development and metrics/reporting.
•	Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including executive reporting.
•	Hands-on familiarity with enterprise and cloud environments (e.g., Microsoft AD, Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS) and common security controls (firewalls, EDR/SIEM, WAF, IAM).
•	Ability to work independently across concurrent engagements, meeting deadlines and quality expectations.

Qualifications & Experience?
•	Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
•	10+ years’ total experience in information security, including 4+ years in security consulting and/or GRC leadership roles.
•	Experience working within international or multinational organisations (particularly in the telecommunications or banking sectors) is highly regarded. 
•	Exposure to global security standards and cross-border GRC or cybersecurity programs across diverse geographic environments is strongly preferred.
•	Must hold at least three of the following relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer, and ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor.
•	Evidence of continuing professional development and familiarity with current threat and compliance landscapes.

Right to Work Requirement:
Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia at the time of application.  

Working Conditions
This is a permanent base role, with hybrid work arrangement (2 days remote + 3 days from office) and open to candidates in Melbourne that have full working right/visa.
Hybrid work model (on-site client meetings as required). Some interstate travel may be required based on client needs.

Summary

Our client is seeking to add a Civil Engineering Draftsperson to its residential building and construction business based in Guildford, New South Wales. Ozi Homes Pty Ltd supports the planning and delivery of residential construction projects and requires a capable draftsperson to prepare accurate civil engineering drawings, technical plans and supporting documentation across construction, site development and project coordination activities.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Preparing detailed civil engineering drawings and technical plans for construction and infrastructure projects.
- Producing site layouts, drainage plans and structural drafting documentation using CAD software.
- Assisting engineers with drafting support across residential and commercial building developments.
- Reviewing engineering sketches and converting concepts into accurate technical construction drawings.
- Preparing plans for stormwater, sewerage and civil infrastructure construction works.
- Interpreting engineering instructions and applying drafting procedures to project documentation requirements.
- Coordinating drawing revisions based on engineering feedback and construction site requirements.
- Maintaining accurate drawing registers, technical records and drafting version control procedures.
- Liaising with engineers, project managers and contractors regarding drafting updates and specifications.
- Ensuring engineering drawings comply with Australian standards, regulations and contract requirements.
- Preparing sketches, charts and tabulated information supporting engineering and construction activities.
- Conducting quantity calculations and assisting with material estimation for civil construction projects.
- Supporting construction teams with technical drafting information during project delivery stages.
- Inspecting completed drafting work to ensure accuracy, consistency and compliance requirements.
- Assisting with project coordination and resolving drafting discrepancies during construction activities.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Diploma or Advanced Diploma qualification in Civil Engineering Drafting, Engineering Design or closely related technical discipline.
- Minimum 12 months experience preparing civil engineering drawings using industry-standard CAD drafting software within construction environments.
- Comprehensive understanding of Australian construction standards, engineering documentation requirements and relevant regulatory compliance obligations.
- Ability to interpret technical engineering information and prepare accurate construction and infrastructure drafting documentation independently.
- Experience supporting residential and commercial construction projects with high levels of drafting accuracy and technical detail.
- Well-developed communication skills when liaising with engineers, contractors, project managers and external construction stakeholders professionally.
- Strong organisational abilities managing multiple drafting priorities while maintaining documentation accuracy and project delivery deadlines consistently.
- Practical knowledge of drainage, sewerage, infrastructure and site development drafting within Australian construction project environments.
